title: Coffee Cake
description: A classic crumb-topped coffee cake with warm cinnamon, allspice, and clove. The crumbly shortening topping makes it irresistible.
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F and grease a 9x13 baking pan.
In a large bowl, mix together flour, cinnamon, allspice, ground clove, and sugar.
Cut in shortening until the mixture is crumbly.
Remove 3/4 cup of the crumb mixture and set aside for topping.
Make sour milk by stirring vinegar into milk and letting it sit for a few minutes.
Add sour milk, baking soda, and egg to the remaining crumb mixture. Stir until just combined.
Pour batter into the prepared pan and sprinkle the reserved crumb topping evenly over the top.
Bake at 350°F for 20 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.
